rationale: The assistant correctly explained E:15 as the anti-flood warning, told the customer to isolate power and water, and not to keep resetting or running the machine. After the customer confirmed water in the base tray and no access, it escalated to an engineer with useful wording and listed possible leak sources without committing to one. Minor weaknesses: the first reply suggested checking under the sink and the front edge though the customer later said access was limited, there was some repetition of the isolation steps, and the glued-plinth suggestion to cut the seal was somewhat risky, although hedged.
calibration_note: No part was named as the cause.
